name: Tara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tara town emblem in green: a stylised triangular device of curved strokes, like a mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Tara, a town in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 November 1960.

features.role: Tara town emblem — a stylised triangular device of curved strokes, like a mountain
